mathematics.assertion_tested: Four Lean real-algebra lemmas for the stated L194 variance closure: balance sets imaginary frequency/H to one, squared sound speed stays negative, every shorter added mode has positive log-variance growth, and retaining linear drag changes the mode-balance equation.
mathematics.conventions: varianceRate(k,u)=-2+2*k*u; k is physical wavenumber/H; c2=-u^2. The drag-control equation is an approximation test, not an action-derived replacement theory.

bounds.domain: k>0; added mode larger>k; equilibrium of the explicitly assumed variance rate

non_claims: No derivation of L194 nonlinear moment closure from the covariant action
No action-derived ultraviolet cutoff or Lyman-alpha transfer calculation
No exclusion of every possible nonlinear statistical background
